clue.text: No East End gangster given bird

indicators.note: No East End tells us to drop E, the abbreviation for East, from the end of the gangster's name

parts.note: Al Capone was the notorious Chicago gangster

explanation.surface: A Cockney villain is presented with a bird, perhaps a turkey at Christmas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'East End' looks like London's Cockney district; here it says remove E (East) from the end. CAPONE loses its final E.
explanation.definitionFit: A capon is a castrated cockerel fattened for the table, a kind of domestic fowl.

clue.text: Bad-tempered taxi driver run in

indicators.note: in tells us the run letter is placed inside the word for a cab driver

parts.note: a cabby is an informal word for a taxi driver
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: An irritable cabbie is taken in by the police.
explanation.definitionFit: Crabby is an informal synonym for irritable and grumpy.

clue.text: American lout making an appearance in Pennsylvania

indicators.note: in says the phrase for a look goes inside the state's abbreviation

parts.note: PA is the postal abbreviation for Pennsylvania
an gives the single letter A
a look is an appearance

explanation.surface: A loutish American turns up in Pennsylvania.
explanation.definitionFit: Palooka is US slang for a stupid, clumsy or oafish person.

clue.text: After fifteen days, character's not finished book

indicators.note: After places the shortened character word behind the half-month piece

parts.note: fifteen days is half of November's thirty, so the first half of that month's name

indicators.note: not finished means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: a letter is a character of the alphabet; the 's is a link meaning 'is'

explanation.surface: Two weeks in, someone has failed to finish reading a book.
explanation.walkthrough: The month is never named: fifteen days is half of November, so take the first half of NOVEMBER, NOVE. LETTER with its last letter gone gives LETTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A novelette is a short novel, a slight book of light fiction.

clue.text: Person in court mentioned minor instance of air rage?

indicators.note: mentioned signals that the words are said out loud and spelt another way

parts.note: a small quarrel on an aircraft would be a plane tiff

explanation.surface: Someone in court refers to a passenger's small outburst on a flight.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaintiff is the party who brings a civil action in a law court.

clue.text: Little angel proving a true oaf when going off the rails

indicators.note: going off the rails describes things going wildly wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A supposed little angel shows they are a real oaf by going astray.
explanation.definitionFit: A child called a little angel is a model of good behaviour, a perfect example of goodness.

clue.text: Air current in December is novel

definitions.meaning: a song that is popular in the festive season, a seasonal tune

explanation.definitionFit: A carol is a festive song heard everywhere at Christmas, and the Dickens ghost story bears that title.

clue.text: Rock musician finally appeared half cut

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word musician
half cut says only the first half of the word appeared is kept

explanation.surface: A rock musician turned up tipsy at the end of the night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock musician' reads as one phrase, but Rock is the definition. 'Half cut' is British slang for drunk; here it keeps APPE, the front half of APPEARED.
explanation.definitionFit: A nappe is a large sheet of rock folded or thrust over adjacent strata in geology.

clue.text: I married partner, gathering round a cleric's office

indicators.note: gathering round means the other pieces enclose the single letter

parts.note: a mate is a partner

explanation.surface: Someone describes marrying a partner who embraces a churchman's duties.
explanation.definitionFit: An imamate is the office, rank or territory of an imam, a Muslim religious leader.

clue.text: Leaders of feudal regime need me to reform slaves no longer

indicators.note: Leaders of picks the opening letter of each of the next two words
to reform means to reshape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Under a feudal regime, someone is needed to reform the system and free the serfs.
explanation.definitionFit: Freedmen are people released from slavery, emancipated former slaves.

clue.text: Everywhere is in a state of disorder

definitions.meaning: found in every location, scattered widely

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both spread far and wide and in a complete muddle.

clue.text: Illegally sell port by the gallon

parts.note: Bootle is a port town on Merseyside, next to Liverpool
G is the abbreviation for gallon

explanation.surface: Port wine is being sold on the black market in gallon quantities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' suggests the fortified wine; it is BOOTLE, a dock town beside Liverpool in north-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: To bootleg is to make or trade goods, especially liquor, unlawfully.

clue.text: Whence Bjork single, recording that contains style

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, a single

indicators.note: that contains says the disc piece wraps around the word for flair

parts.note: a CD is a compact disc recording
elan is flair or style

explanation.surface: The source of Bjork's latest single, a stylish recording.
explanation.definitionFit: The singer Bjork comes from this Nordic island nation, so it is her place of origin.

clue.text: French girl with little time for strict disciplinarian

parts.note: Martine is a French girl's name
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A French girl has little patience with a stern taskmaster.
explanation.definitionFit: A martinet, named after a severe drillmaster in Louis XIV's army, is a stickler for discipline.

clue.text: Line from a letter read aloud

indicators.note: read aloud signals that what is spoken is spelt differently

parts.note: the letter Q, whose name is pronounced like the answer

explanation.surface: A line taken from a letter that is read out.
explanation.definitionFit: A queue is a line of people waiting their turn.

clue.text: Victoria sponge?

parts.note: Victoria was a monarch, so a sponge named for her would be a royal bake

explanation.definitionFit: A queen cake is a small light currant sponge, and Victoria was a reigning monarch.

clue.text: Supports star player on baseball team

parts.note: backs means supports
top means star, as in top of the bill

explanation.surface: A team's star baseball player is the one fans get behind.
explanation.definitionFit: In baseball the catcher, crouching behind home plate, is informally called the backstop.

clue.text: Brokeback Mountain director briefly expressed point of view

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, losing the final letter

parts.note: Ang Lee directed the film Brokeback Mountain

explanation.surface: A film-maker states his perspective in a few words.
explanation.definitionFit: An angle is a particular standpoint or way of looking at something.

clue.text: Great to unwind a length of wire

indicators.note: unwind suggests uncoiling into a new arrangement of letters

explanation.surface: It feels great to uncoil some wire.
explanation.definitionFit: A garotte is a strangling cord or wire used as a weapon.

clue.text: Dance music appears loud to injured officer

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud
lame means injured, especially in the leg
NCO is a non-commissioned officer

explanation.surface: The dance tune sounds deafening to a wounded soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Flamenco is Andalusian music and dance with guitar, singing and stamping.

clue.text: Expression of surprise by man on board preparing food

parts.note: coo is a British exclamation of surprise
the king is a chess piece, a man on the board

explanation.surface: A gasp of surprise from a crew member as dinner is made on a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man on board' hints at a sailor; it is a chessman.
explanation.definitionFit: Cooking is the making of meals by heating ingredients.

clue.text: Famous actor, typical househusband?

definitions.meaning: a modern, reformed man who does the housework

explanation.definitionFit: Paul Newman starred in many films, and a househusband exemplifies the modern new man.

clue.text: Capital once invested in Ankara, chiefly

indicators.note: invested in means placed inside, so the answer sits within the words

explanation.surface: Money is mainly put into the Turkish capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' looks like money, and Ankara like the capital meant; the answer is the former capital of Pakistan.
explanation.definitionFit: Karachi was Pakistan's capital until 1959, when the seat of government moved.

clue.text: Woman takes Conservative peer round House of Lords

indicators.note: round means the peer's name surrounds the abbreviation

parts.note: Sebastian Coe, the former athlete, sits as Lord Coe, a Conservative peer
HL is the abbreviation for House of Lords

explanation.surface: A woman escorts a Tory lord around the upper chamber.
explanation.definitionFit: Chloe is a female first name.

clue.text: Approve of criminal getting convicted

parts.note: con is short for convict, a criminal
done is slang for convicted, as in done for theft

explanation.surface: Someone excuses a crook who has been found guilty.
explanation.definitionFit: To condone is to accept or overlook wrongdoing, implicitly allowing it.

clue.text: A NATO militarist sorted out a system of government

indicators.note: sorted out means put in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A warmongering NATO officer has been dealt with.
explanation.definitionFit: Totalitarianism is a regime of centralised, dictatorial state control.

clue.text: Heard quiet male becoming animated bit by bit

indicators.note: Heard tells us the word for quiet is spoken and spelt differently

parts.note: peace means quiet, tranquillity

indicators.note: becoming animated means getting lively, so the letters move about

explanation.surface: A calm man is heard getting excited one step at a time.
explanation.definitionFit: Piecemeal describes something done gradually, a portion at a time.

clue.text: Gielgud Centre in Scottish town

indicators.note: Centre takes the middle letters of the actor's surname

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Gielgud appears at a theatre centre in a Scottish town.
explanation.walkthrough: John Gielgud was a famous English actor; ELG is the centre of his surname.
explanation.definitionFit: Elgin is a historic town in Moray, north-east Scotland.
